data.gender_notes: Mawjud is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root m-w-j, meaning 'present' or 'existent'. In Islamic context, it is used to describe Allah's omnipresence and His eternal existence. It is also used as a male given name. The name Mawjud carries the meaning “Present, Existent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mawjud usually hope their child will grow to embody present, existent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mawjud total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

The name also symbolizes the concept of tawhid, the belief in the Unity of God, as it emphasizes the idea that Allah is always present and close to us.

It encourages the believer to remember Allah in all aspects of life, and to seek His guidance and help in times of need. The name also symbolizes the concept of submission to Allah and the belief in His supremacy and power over all things. Ultimately, the name "Mawjud" serves as a source of inspiration and motivation for believers to strive for closer proximity to Allah and to live in accordance with His divine will.
